intent: Warn when an application image already carries a build-time JVM cache
Inspect image config and warn about overlapping build-time JVM caches

title: inspect image metadata during preview and keep inspection best-effort
why: The rendered Kubernetes manifest omits image defaults, so cache flags and framework markers can only be detected from the image config. Preview must stay advisory when registry metadata is unavailable.
alternative: Require image inspection to succeed or pull the full image — rejected: registry access or image layers would block an informational preview.

title: keep explicit Java launches and use image defaults for preview warnings only
why: The injector transforms manifests offline and currently requires an explicit Java command. Deriving commands from image defaults would make actual injection depend on registry access and would expand this warning issue into new launch support.
alternative: Resolve image defaults for every injection — rejected: it changes deployment behavior and makes transformation depend on remote metadata access.

intent: Share registry transport and read OCI runtime config

title: reuse one OCI HTTP transport for archive and image config reads
why: Image inspection needs the same Bearer challenge, token refresh, HTTPS redirect and credential-boundary handling as archive access. Sharing the transport avoids a second security-sensitive implementation.
alternative: Add a second image-only HTTP client — rejected: auth and redirect rules would drift between registry consumers.

name: OciRegistryHttp
role: Performs registry HTTP requests with Bearer or Basic challenge handling, token refresh, timeouts and redirects that do not forward credentials across origins.
conditions: Shared by archive-store operations and OCI image metadata reads; registry calls request only the permissions named by their scope.

name: OciImageConfigReader
role: Reads platform manifests and the OCI runtime config blob without downloading filesystem layers.
conditions: Checks SHA-256 before parsing runtime settings; limits metadata reads to 4 MiB and inspects at most 32 platform manifests.

subject: Image config is runtime metadata, not image layers
why: Entrypoint, Cmd, Env and labels are in the config blob referenced by a manifest. Downloading image layers would add large and unnecessary work to a preview warning.

intent: Inspect image cache markers in preview and document cache compatibility limits

title: warn about detected cache compatibility without claiming precedence
why: Image metadata and framework flags can indicate a baked cache, but Kubernetes may override image defaults and JDK 25 rejects mixed AOTCache and SharedArchiveFile flags. The warning must expose the signal without claiming which cache wins.
alternative: Say the cluster archive takes precedence — rejected: a mixed JDK 25 launch can fail VM initialization rather than select one cache.

name: OciRegistryHttp
role: Shared registry transport for OCI archive and image-config requests, including bearer auth, redirect handling, token refresh, and credential-boundary checks.
conditions: Construct it with a registry base URI, repository, auth provider, and timeout. Image metadata reads use HTTPS; plain HTTP is package-private for tests.

name: OciImageConfigReader
role: Reads an OCI manifest or index and the small runtime config blob for each platform, then exposes Entrypoint, Cmd, Env, and Labels to preview inspection.
conditions: Bounds JSON to 4 MiB, verifies config SHA-256, caps platform manifests, and never fetches layers. Its runtime values must not be printed.

name: OfflineInjector.previewImageWarnings
role: Best-effort, preview-only detector that turns known cache signals into sanitized warnings.
conditions: Only opted-in Deployments are inspected. Registry failures produce an unknown-presence note; ordinary inject does not call the inspector.

subject: JDK 25 mixed cache flags
why: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS containing -XX:AOTCache together with a launch -XX:SharedArchiveFile fails VM initialization on OpenJDK 25.0.1. Matching AOTCache flags started normally in the local check; other JDK versions and framework images remain unverified.

intent: Complete preview cache detection, compatibility docs, and feature distillations
